stickman-school-run.title: Stickman School Run: Leap & Overcome Obstacles
stickman-school-run.slogan: Dash through tricky terrain and clear all the levels!
stickman-school-run.description: Leap and overcome obstacles to let the boy reach the position of his lover in Stickman School Run. This school-themed game offers creative running and jumping gameplay. Control a stickman, navigating through challenging platforms and obstacles. With 100 levels, each designed to test your flexibility and quick reactions, Stickman School Run keeps you engaged and focused. Play now and experience the mix of magic and challenge!

HomeIframe.title: Stickman School Run
HomeIframe.description: Experience the thrill of Stickman School Run, a game that combines creativity and challenge. Navigate through 100 levels, each offering unique obstacles and platforms. Play now and see if you can reach the end!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Stickman School Run is a school-themed game where you control a stickman, navigating through challenging platforms and obstacles to reach his girlfriend.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Press the up arrow key to make the character jump up.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Hold down the up arrow key to zoom in on the ruler, pushing back boxes that get in the way.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Use the right arrow key to curl the character, avoiding collisions with the combo.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Each level is designed to test your flexibility and quick reactions.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Maps can change when you replay a level, offering new challenges each time.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Control a stickman, navigating through unique obstacles and platforms.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Use different commands to overcome various types of obstacles.
